lines.02: Acme est votre boîte de réception de commentaires.
lines.03: Chaque demande de chaque canal arrive dans une seule boîte de réception.
lines.04: Acme marque chacun d’eux et regroupe les modèles.
lines.05: Ce qui compte figure en tête de votre feuille de route.
lines.06: Boîte de réception, balises et feuille de route, le tout au même endroit.

_i18n.voice: silent animatic (no recorded take in this language) - record vo/body-equivalent takes and point voice_dir at them for a voiced render

lines_en.03: Every request from every channel lands in one inbox.
lines_en.04: Acme tags each one and groups the patterns.
lines_en.05: What matters rises to the top of your roadmap.
lines_en.06: Inbox, tags and roadmap, all in one place.

_i18n.note: Machine-translated. Word anchors (until/push_at/merge_at/flip_at/chip.at/cursor.at) were position-remapped, not semantically translated - they pick the translated word at the same place in the sentence the English anchor held, so build.py never crashes on a missing word. Have a native speaker read lines + on-screen text before this ships; set reviewed: true after.
